cases.name: Planner creates a bounded typed DAG and prevents free-form action authority
Durable enqueue is idempotent and preserves exact workspace hash
D1 tasks execute extraction and reach HUMAN_WAIT without approving facts
Named human decisions and explicit resume unlock candidate authoring; draft approval remains another wait
Provider outage protocol mock retries three times with backoff then DLQ, no fake draft
Unavailable model configuration persists HOLD and explicit manual fallback continues
Lease expiry reclaims interrupted task using CAS and a new lease token
Concurrent workers commit one task result and one exact revision
External workspace edit blocks stale runtime before tools or authoring
Pause and cancel are persisted and prevent subsequent task execution
Replan creates new DAG generation and keeps prior task records
Revoked creator membership blocks autonomous execution
Runtime API rejects anonymous, wrong-origin, and invalid worker credentials
Claim domain binds exact original source hashes and blocks stale input
Approved exact draft advances to unsigned controlled package with release false
Cancel during asynchronous provider work prevents artifact commit
Malformed binary original hash is held before deterministic document parsing
Revoked or downgraded creator cannot replay an idempotent enqueue result
Authenticated viewer cannot tick an empty workspace
Workspace mutation between control preparation and CAS blocks all control writes
Response human gate requires independent current revision and never records an authority outcome

boundary: Actual local Miniflare D1/R2 and authenticated API-handler tests. Provider failure/retry inputs are explicit protocol mocks; hosted scheduling and live model quality not tested.
